visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with a white towel wrapped like a turban around her head holds a small brown bottle of milk tea in a brightly lit indoor setting. (2) The scene shifts to a retail store display at Loft, showing various bath oil packets shaped like colorful beverage bottles on shelves. (3) Close-up shots of two packets, 'Strawberry Milk' and 'Coffee Milk,' are shown on a white counter; a hand points to the back label. (4) Dark brown liquid is poured from a packet into a bathtub filled with pale green water, which immediately starts to emulsify into a milky white-brown color. (5) A hand is seen swirling the water in the tub, mixing the liquid until it becomes a consistent milky texture with some reddish objects floating. (6) Pink liquid is poured into the tub from another packet, turning the water into a vibrant pink-purple milky hue as a hand scoops and tests the texture.

It combines a travel vlog element (finding it at Loft) with a practical demonstration of the product's emulsification and scent intensity to engage viewers interested in unique Japanese shopping finds.
